enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Close eyes. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Turn onto the left side. Adjust the pillow under the head. Keep the arms under the blanket. Turn onto the right side. Stretch the legs. Pull the blanket back up. Turn onto the back. Rest the head on the pillow. Remain still under the blanket. Turn onto the left side again. Pull the blanket over the shoulder. Remain lying down.

enriched_activities.activity: Morning wash, brushing teeth, and getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Sit up on the bed. Swing the legs off the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Reach for the light switch. Turn on the light. Step to the toilet. Lift the toilet seat. Urinate. Flush the toilet. Walk to the sink. Turn on the tap. Put both hands under the water. Rub the face with both hands. Turn off the tap. Pick up the toothbrush. Turn on the tap. Wet the toothbrush. Turn off the tap. Pick up the toothpaste. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Put the toothpaste down. Brush the teeth. Spit into the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the mouth. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face. Hang the towel back on the hook. Walk to Bedroom 2. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a top. Take out trousers. Pull on the trousers. Pull on the top. Close the wardrobe door.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, brewing tea with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out eggs and bread. Close the refrigerator door. Put the bread into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Open the cupboard. Take out a pan. Put the pan on the induction cooker. Press the induction cooker power button. Crack the eggs into the pan. Pick up a spatula. Stir the eggs. Turn off the induction cooker. Take the toast out of the toaster. Put the eggs and toast on a plate. Pick up a kettle. Fill the kettle with water from the tap. Put the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch on. Take out a mug and a tea bag. Put the tea bag into the mug. Pour hot water from the kettle into the mug. Sit down at the table. Eat the eggs and toast. Drink the tea. Stand up. Carry the plate and mug to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the plate and mug. Turn off the tap.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking emails and phone messages, planning the day's arts administration tasks and illustration commissions at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the desk. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Press the desk lamp switch on. Pick up the phone. Unlock the phone. Tap the email app. Scroll through emails. Open a message. Tap reply. Type a reply. Send the reply. Tap the message app. Read messages. Put the phone down on the desk. Press the computer power button. Wait for the screen to load. Move the mouse. Click the email client. Open new emails. Type responses on the keyboard. Click the calendar. Enter tasks for the day. Type task notes. Open a document. Type the task list. Save the document.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on arts administration duties and grant paperwork on the computer, sketching illustration concepts on the monitor
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at the desk. Move the mouse. Open the browser. Click the grant application portal. Log in with username and password. Scroll through the grant form. Click the first field. Type the project title. Click the next field. Type the budget figures. Open a spreadsheet. Copy figures. Paste figures into the form. Upload a document. Open the email client. Read a new email. Type a reply. Send the reply. Open the illustration software. Create a new canvas. Pick the brush tool. Sketch outline shapes on the monitor. Draw a rough figure. Adjust the brush size. Add a second sketch layer. Draw background shapes. Save the file. Open the grant form again. Type the project description. Save the draft.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch with Member 1, washing up dishes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Say hello to Member 1. Open the refrigerator door. Take out vegetables and cheese. Close the refrigerator door. Put the vegetables on the counter. Pick up a knife. Cut the vegetables. Take out plates. Put the food on the plates. Carry the plates to the table. Sit down opposite Member 1. Eat the lunch. Talk with Member 1 about the day's work. Stand up. Carry the plates to the sink. Turn on the tap. Pick up the sponge. Wipe the plates. Rinse the plates. Put the plates in the rack. Turn off the tap. Wipe the counter with a cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing arts administration correspondence and project scheduling on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the desk. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Move the mouse. Wake the computer screen. Open the email client. Read new emails. Click a message from a partner. Type a reply. Attach a file. Send the reply. Open the calendar. Click a date. Type a new event. Set the time for the event. Save the event. Open the project schedule document. Type new deadlines. Adjust the task order. Highlight a row. Save the document. Open the browser. Search an arts funding website. Scroll through the page. Copy a deadline date. Paste it into the schedule. Save the schedule.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short tea break with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair. Walk to the kitchen. Say hello to Member 1. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water from the tap. Put the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch on. Take out two mugs. Put tea bags into the mugs. Wait for the water to boil. Pour hot water into both mugs. Hand one mug to Member 1. Sit down at the table. Sip the tea. Talk with Member 1. Stand up. Carry the mugs to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the mugs. Turn off the tap.

enriched_activities.activity: Drafting and refining freelance illustration artwork on the monitor
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the desk. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Move the mouse. Open the illustration software. Open the commission file. Select the brush tool. Draw the main character outline on the monitor. Adjust the brush size. Add shading to the figure. Pick the eraser tool. Erase the stray lines. Pick the fill tool. Fill the character with color. Open the layers panel. Create a new layer. Draw the background elements. Adjust the layer opacity. Zoom in on the face. Add detail lines to the face. Zoom out. Save the file. Open a reference image. Compare the artwork with the reference. Adjust the color palette. Save the file again.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing with Member 1, watching TV and listening to music
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair. Walk to the living room. Sit down on the sofa next to Member 1. Pick up the TV remote. Press the power button. Point the remote at the TV. Change the channel. Put the remote down. Pick up the phone. Open the music app. Tap a playlist. Put the phone on the armrest. Lean back on the sofa. Talk with Member 1. Watch the TV screen.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying the living room with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the sofa. Pick up the mugs from the coffee table. Carry the mugs to the kitchen. Walk back to the living room. Pick up the cushions from the floor. Put the cushions on the sofa. Fold the blanket. Put the blanket on the sofa armrest. Pick up the TV remote. Put the remote on the coffee table. Pick up the phone. Put the phone in the pocket. Wipe the coffee table with a cloth. Push the chairs back under the table. Say to Member 1 that the room is tidy.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out meat and vegetables. Close the refrigerator door. Put the ingredients on the counter. Pick up a knife. Cut the vegetables. Open the cupboard. Take out a pan. Put the pan on the induction cooker. Press the induction cooker power button. Pour oil into the pan. Add the vegetables. Stir with a spatula. Add the meat. Stir again. Add salt. Turn off the induction cooker. Take out two plates. Put the food on the plates. Carry the plates to the table. Sit down with Member 1. Eat dinner. Talk with Member 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up the kitchen after dinner with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the table. Carry the plates to the sink. Turn on the tap. Pick up the sponge. Wipe the plates. Rinse the plates. Put the plates in the rack. Turn off the tap. Pick up the pan. Wash the pan with the sponge. Rinse the pan. Put the pan on the rack. Wipe the counter with a cloth. Put the leftovers in a container. Open the refrigerator door. Put the container inside. Close the refrigerator door. Wipe the table with a cloth. Turn off the light.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and watching TV with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the living room. Sit down on the sofa next to Member 1. Pick up a book from the coffee table. Open the book. Read a page. Turn the page. Look up at the TV screen. Pick up the TV remote. Press the volume button. Put the remote down. Read another page. Turn the page. Say goodnight to Member 1. Stand up. Carry the book to Bedroom 2.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on personal freelance illustration projects on the computer, with the space heater on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 2. Put the book on the desk. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Press the desk lamp switch on. Bend down. Press the space heater power button. Press the heater heat setting button. Move the mouse. Wake the computer screen. Open the illustration software. Open the personal project file. Select the brush tool. Draw the composition outline on the monitor. Adjust the brush size. Add shading. Pick the fill tool. Fill shapes with color. Open the layers panel. Create a new layer. Draw foreground details. Adjust the layer opacity. Zoom in on the details. Add fine lines. Zoom out. Open a reference photo. Compare with the artwork. Adjust the color palette. Save the file. Open the email client. Check new messages. Type a short reply. Send the reply. Save the file again. Press the space heater power button off. Press the desk lamp switch off. Stand up.

Walk to the bathroom. Push the door open. Reach for the light switch. Turn on the light. Press the water heater switch on. Take off clothes. Put the clothes in the laundry basket. Open the shower door. Step into the shower. Turn on the shower tap. Wet the body. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap on the body. Rinse the body. Pick up the shampoo. Pour shampoo into the hand. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair. Turn off the shower tap. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel. Dry the body with the towel. Dry the hair with the towel. Wipe the mirror with the hand. Pick up the face cream. Open the lid. Apply cream to the face. Close the lid. Put the cream down. Put on clean clothes. Hang the towel on the hook. Turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading briefly and going to sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 2. Pick up the book from the desk. Sit on the edge of the bed. Open the book. Read a page. Turn the page. Read another page. Close the book. Put the book on the nightstand. Stand up. Pull back the blanket. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Turn onto the left side. Adjust the pillow under the head. Close eyes. Remain lying still under the blanket.
